dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Have you seen the music festival? The resounding echoes are sure to reach places farther than the Xiao Lanterns do...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps you'll even be able to hear the music from atop the hills of Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Little Liu... I miss you so much...
